/* Formatted on 9/15/2026 11:59:09 AM (QP5 v5.362) */
SELECT r.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
       s.STATUS_NAME,
       r.REQUEST_DATE,
       r.MAKER_ID,
       r.REQUEST_COMMENT,REQUEST_TYPE_ID,
			 RAWTOHEX(r.request_id)request_id 
  FROM MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST  r
       JOIN MMS_REQUEST_STATUS s ON r.STATUS_ID = s.STATUS_ID
       where  r.MERCHANT_ID=  {{iMerchant.selectedOptionValue}} and r.REQUEST_TYPE_ID = 1
